req.title: Delete only by author
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden when a user attempts to delete a post they did not author.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[5] having kind=negative but heuristic=STC. STC (State Transition Coverage) is appropriate for boundary or positive kinds when tracing state changes, but for a negative test the correct heuristic is NEG (negative testing) or DT (decision table). Since test[5] exercises a third-user authorization failure — a straightforward negative equivalence partition — the fix is to change heuristic from STC to NEG. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_author_can_delete_own_post_returns_redirect
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with standard fixture rows
Post id=2 authored by user id=1 (Rahul, password=stone)
trace: R-FLASKR-020: author is permitted — success path
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r.status_code == 302

r = client.post('/2/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
os.unlink(path)
